thread:
alex: Taking over morning handoff. Quick snapshot:
- Incidents: embeddings-eu-west1 latency spike (INF-493), regen timeouts on /v1/chat (brief)
- Current status: embeddings degraded -> partial recovery after scale action. regen timeouts intermittent but requests still succeed with retries.

alex: Mitigations applied: scaled dedicated pool to 6 nodes, forced KV cache warmup on recent prefixes, bumped autoscaler min to 4 while we observe. Added fallback model variant for critical customers.

ops-bot: alert: embeddings-eu-west1 latency > 2s for 7m; incident INF-493 created by ops-bot at 3315551200

maya: Thanks. I saw the autoscaler churn earlier — are we still seeing any thundering herd from the ingest job?

alex: Not anymore, turned down batch ingest and rolled restart of the ingest worker group at 3315551220. Logs looked like repeated hot-starts.

jin: ping @alex — I have a small patch (PR #7623) that changes kv-prefetch window; can deploy to canary if you want to test reduced latency for cold prefixes.

alex: Please do canary. Scope it to eu-west1 only. If it helps we'll promote. Notify here with deploy-bot output.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for PR #7623 -> target: eu-west1-canary at 3315551250

alex: Quick runbook note: if embeddings error rate rises >1% for 5m, rollback kv-prefetch change, scale to 8 nodes, and re-enable aggressive prefix caching.

sasha: On the regen timeouts — I left a retry patch in staging that increases function-calling timeouts to 45s; will promote after canary if no regressions.

maya: Also FYI, support flagged two enterprise customers seeing 502s — likely correlated with the regen timeouts. I filed a support alert and attached sample request ids.

alex: Good catch. Priority for first hour: monitor regen 95p latency, watch for 502s. If 502s > 3 over a 10m window, enable fallback model variant (policy: immediate fallback).

jin: Canary reported initial latency drop ~8% for cold prefixes. No errors in first 2m.

deploy-bot: canary deploy succeeded at 3315551275 for PR #7623 (eu-west1-canary). No new errors observed in metric window.

alex: Great. Next steps for overnight: 1) leave autoscaler min=4 for 2h, 2) if regen 95p stays < 1.8s, scale back to default autoscaler policy, 3) jin/sasha follow up with a postmortem draft if INF-493 persists.

maya: I'll own customer comms for the two flagged customers — will send templated note and PR to support thread.

jin: I'll monitor canary and queue the PR for full rollout if stable for 30m.

sasha: I'll promote the timeout patch if canary stays green.

alex: Anything else?

maya: One small ask — @jin can you also drop a note in #docs about the kv-prefetch flag and its caveats?

jin: Yup will do. Leaving a short blurb after rollout.

alex: Okay handoff complete. I'm on until 12:30 UTC. If anything spikes, page me. :+1:

ops-bot: reminder: runbook check — validate KV cache hit rate and top prefixes every 15m during incident windows.
